cn_title: 史克威尔称《王国之心》图非AI生成
subtitle: 争议未平
summary: 史克威尔艾尼克斯称，《王国之心》合集1-3争议主视觉未使用生成式AI，问题属于人为失误，已酌情更新素材。不过部分画面瑕疵尚存，不少玩家仍不买账。
opus_summary: 史克威尔艾尼克斯称，《王国之心》合集1-3争议主视觉未使用生成式AI，问题属于人为失误，已酌情更新素材。不过部分画面瑕疵尚存，不少玩家仍不买账。

paragraphs.en: The controversial key art for Kingdom Hearts Collection 1-3 did not contain any AI-generated materials and was actually the result of "human error," according to a new statement from Square Enix.
paragraphs.cn: 史克威尔艾尼克斯在一份新声明中称，《王国之心》合集1-3引发争议的主视觉没有包含任何AI生成素材，问题实际上源于「人为失误」。

paragraphs.en: Fans have been trying to unlock the mystery behind some strange and concerning art posted by the publisher since it was revealed in June. The illustration in question arrived alongside the reveal that Kingdom Hearts Collection 1-3 would soon come to PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X | S, but it didn't take long for players to notice a few worrying details.
paragraphs.cn: 自这家发行商6月公布几张奇怪且令人担忧的画面以来，粉丝一直在试图解开其中的谜团。该插画随《王国之心》合集1-3即将登陆PC、Nintendo Switch 2、PlayStation 5和XBOX Series的消息一同公布，但玩家很快就发现了几个令人不安的细节。

paragraphs.en: Social media posts following the announcement quickly took aim at the chain on Mickey Mouse's Keyblade, the hands on the Traverse Town clocktower, and the details on the bottom of Sora's shoes. The real canary in the coal mine, though, were Donald Duck's hands, with one featuring four fingers, while the other featured five. These supposed pieces of evidence had fans believing Square Enix used artificial intelligence to generate additional details for an existing art piece, but the publisher has finally chimed in to refute these claims.
paragraphs.cn: 消息公布后，社交媒体帖文很快把矛头对准米老鼠Keyblade上的链条、Traverse Town钟楼上的手，以及索拉鞋底的细节。不过，真正的危险信号是唐老鸭的手：一只画了四根手指，另一只却有五根。这些所谓证据让粉丝相信，史克威尔艾尼克斯利用人工智能为已有画作生成了额外细节；如今这家发行商终于出面否认了相关说法。

paragraphs.en: This appears Ai generated or Ai enhanced, can you make a statement regarding this? Very disappointed to see this. pic.twitter.com/IMhwrhB0Y3
paragraphs.cn: 这看起来像是AI生成或经AI增强的。你们能就此发表声明吗？看到这个非常失望。

paragraphs.en: In a statement shared with GameSpot , a Square Enix representative said that the publisher has heard the feedback and made changes where necessary. More importantly, though, the message stated that no genAI was used for any version of the image.
paragraphs.cn: 一名史克威尔艾尼克斯代表在向GameSpot提供的声明中说，这家发行商已听取反馈，并在必要处作出调整。更重要的是，声明称该图的所有版本均未使用生成式AI。

paragraphs.en: "We’re aware of feedback regarding recent Kingdom Hearts visuals," the Square Enix spokesperson told the site via phone call. "These assets were created by our development team without the use of generative AI, and the issues resulted from human error.
paragraphs.cn: 史克威尔艾尼克斯发言人在电话中告诉该网站：「我们已注意到有关近期《王国之心》视觉素材的反馈。这些素材由我们的开发团队制作，未使用生成式AI；出现的问题源于人为失误。」

paragraphs.en: "Quality is extremely important to us, and updated assets have been implemented where appropriate."
paragraphs.cn: 「质量对我们极其重要，我们已在适当处采用更新后的素材。」

paragraphs.en: Square Enix did not clarify how the art came to be in the first place. Additionally, as mentioned by GameSpot, the updated art does seem to have fixed Donald's hand, but other details, such as that muddy-looking clocktower and Sora's shoes, remain. Either way, not everyone is happy with the explanation.
paragraphs.cn: 史克威尔艾尼克斯没有说明这张画最初是如何产生的。此外，正如GameSpot提到的，更新后的画面似乎修好了唐老鸭的手，但那座看起来模糊的钟楼、索拉的鞋子等其他细节仍然存在。不管怎样，并非所有人都接受这一解释。

paragraphs.en: "We’ve found so much of the art that was retrofitted to make the image that I dunno if anyone was arguing that the whole image was AI. It’s just sloppy and bad," one fan on Reddit .
paragraphs.cn: 一名Reddit用户说：「我们找到了大量为拼成这张图而后期拼补的画面；我不知道是否有人声称整张图都是AI生成的。它就是粗糙又糟糕。」

paragraphs.en: "They might as well just scrap this and make new cover art at this point," another . "Even if it's not AI-generated, it's definitely one of the worst KH cover arts. The composition just looks lazy."
paragraphs.cn: 另一名用户说：「事到如今，他们不如干脆废掉这张图，重新做封面。就算不是AI生成的，它也绝对是最差的《王国之心》封面图之一。构图看起来就是很敷衍。」

paragraphs.en: "It was definitely AI," one X/Twitter user suggested . "I love Kingdom Hearts and Square Enix but come on. There's two versions of the picture, one where the characters are separated and one where they're not, and the one where they're not is obvious they used AI for it, which caused it to make extra fingers."
paragraphs.cn: 一名X用户认为：「肯定是AI。我喜欢《王国之心》和史克威尔艾尼克斯，但拜托。这张图有两个版本，一个角色是分开的，另一个不是；后者显然用了AI，才导致它画出了多余的手指。」

paragraphs.en: Kingdom Hearts Collection 1-3 comes to PC, Switch 2, PS5, and Xbox Series X | S October 8, 2026. In the meantime, you can see the latest on Kingdom Hearts 4 , which reappeared shortly after the collection was announced.
paragraphs.cn: 《王国之心》合集1-3将于2026年10月8日登陆PC、Nintendo Switch 2、PlayStation 5和XBOX Series。与此同时，你也可以了解《王国之心4》的最新消息；该作在合集公布后不久再次亮相。
